missing-credential: An API key this step needs isn't set, so nothing was sent.
auth-failed: The provider refused the API key.
insufficient-credits: The provider account is out of credit.
rate-limited: The provider is limiting requests. Try again later.
network: The request got no answer. Check the network connection.
locked: Another run is already working on this persona.
ytdlp-unavailable: yt-dlp isn't installed and couldn't be installed.
cookies-unavailable: yt-dlp couldn't read the browser's cookies, or the site asked for them.
ffmpeg-unavailable: Audio over 5 hours needs ffmpeg to split it. Install ffmpeg and try again.
http-412: The site refused yt-dlp, usually because it is out of date.
no-upload-date: This video has no upload date, so it can't be placed among the streams.
no-speech: No speech was heard in this audio.
